script.description: Original script with scenes, script points and subscenes. All continuity and timing checks run automatically, even without supplied issues or correction_focus.

output_count.description: Number of refined script variations to generate. Defaults to 3.

scene_duration_seconds.description: Target duration allocated per scene in seconds. Defaults to 10.0.

min.description: Minimum words per second for spoken dialogue.

max.description: Maximum words per second for spoken dialogue.

wps_range.description: Target words-per-second (WPS) pacing range governing dialogue timing.

issues_found.description: Optional list of user-specified issues already known or identified in the script.

correction_focus.description: Optional subset of issue types to prioritize during refinement.

examples.script:
INT. OFFICE - DAY
JOHN (laughing happily)
I just lost everything.
EXT. BEACH - NIGHT
MARY (whispering)
Why did we move here so suddenly?

issues_found.description: John is laughing while stating he lost everything.

examples.script:
INT. BROADCAST STUDIO - NIGHT
1. ANCHOR (rapidly reading 60 words)
Tonight we bring you breaking developments from across three continents where emergency meetings have concluded without resolution following hours of intense negotiation.
2. Anchor pauses for 8 seconds.

issues_found.description: Spoken dialogue exceeds 10.0 seconds scene duration limit.
